title: Spec conformance
subtitle: Browse real results from the exact SharpTS revision running this site, from broad language areas down to individual built-ins and features.
percentageFootnote: Percentages count Pass results over all non-skipped results. Every other non-skipped bucket counts as not passing; skipped results are shown separately.
honestyFootnote: Test262 exercises specification edge cases far beyond what typical programs encounter. These totals are presented without adjustment.
